evidence: The frozen workbook Quality Checks!A34:D34 requires ONE full-credit bar, and the frozen quality procedure at references/quality-checks.md:138-140 says a criterion fails this check when it lists requirements then waives most. I parsed and inspected all 31 criterion blocks across the five frozen judge.toml files. One clear instance is task/tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:23: 'Use real keyboard traversal through editor, Format, Find, Run, Save and library/history controls' followed in the same binary criterion by 'A missing named feature is scored by Functional; judge whether the controls actually offered are keyboard usable and focus-visible.' The former makes traversal of every named control the full-credit target; the latter makes usability of only offered controls the target. task/tests/scored/polish/prompt.md:5 adds 'Do not score feature correctness again here' but does not resolve the criterion's incompatible targets. The public ui.md:17 asks for those controls and focus labels, so their absence belongs to Functional ownership while Polish should have an unambiguous keyboard-usability bar. No runtime verdict is claimed; raw-evidence-index.json was absent when checked.
counterexample: A partial app offers a keyboard-reachable editor and Run button but omits Format, Find, Save, library and history. Under 'controls actually offered' it can receive full Polish credit; under 'traversal through' the named controls it fails. Conversely, a conforming app can disable history on a new unsaved draft until a record exists, and a literal fresh-draft traversal of history can fail it even though its enabled controls are keyboard usable and saved-history inspection works after Save.
suggested_fix: Rewrite cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus as one explicit bar for keyboard reachability and visible focus of enabled, offered controls, with a positive probe through the editor and Run plus available library/history after creating a saved record; state that absent feature ownership is Functional without first requiring traversal through absent named controls.
